page_title: HAV 1-4 PSG | Le Havre v PSG 16/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:9.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' 1 - 4 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Arthur Desmas no chance!
89' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) is going to take the penalty!
88' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) is the one who receives a yellow card.
88' Willy Delajod interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Gautier Lloris (Le Havre). PSG are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
87' Here comes a substitution. Kandet Diawara (Le Havre) is brought on as a substitute for Yassine Kechta.

86' 1 - 3 Goal! Bradley Barcola (PSG) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Arthur Desmas had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:3.

85' 1 - 2 Joao Neves sends a superb cross into the box. Ousmane Dembele (PSG) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the top right corner, leaving Arthur Desmas beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:2.
83' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
82' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
82' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, PSG are going to take it.
81' The opposition back off Ousmane Dembele (PSG) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies over the bar. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
80' Some great controlled play and passing from PSG. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
76' Didier Digard has decided to substitute Antoine Joujou and he is replaced by Steve Ngoura (Le Havre).
76' Substitution. Rassoul Ndiaye did his best and is replaced by Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre).
74' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) tackles a bit over-zealously and Willy Delajod blows for a foul. Free kick. PSG will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
73' PSG are seeing far more of the ball now.
71' Here is a change. Marco Asensio is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Bradley Barcola (PSG).
71' Luis Enrique has decided to make a change. Marquinhos (PSG) replaces Yoram Zague.
71' Today's match ends for Kang-In Lee who will be replaced by Ousmane Dembele (PSG).
67' 5:9 – the total goal attempt statistics.
62' Marco Asensio (PSG) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Arthur Desmas makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!

61' Kang-In Lee (PSG) shows off his amazing technique to get in front of goal by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the crossbar. Nice run, but unlucky finish! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
59' PSG have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
58' 29:71 – the ratio of ball possession.
56' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Le Havre due to a handball in the build-up play.
55' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Le Havre players aren’t happy.
55' Goal! Josue Casimir (Le Havre) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:1.
54' PSG take a short corner kick.
51' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Willy Delajod to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Le Havre players can finally celebrate.
50' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Le Havre players aren’t happy.
48' 1 - 1 Christopher Operi floats a lovely ball in from the free kick. Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) gathers the ball and strikes it into the bottom right corner, increasing the score to 1:1.
46' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Ibrahim Mbaye will be replaced by Joao Neves (PSG).
46' Referee Willy Delajod blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' PSG can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+5' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Arthur Desmas pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
45+4' Vitinha (PSG) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+2' This is a yellow card! Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

45' Excellent touch by Marco Asensio (PSG)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
44' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) was too forceful with his tackle and Willy Delajod interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
44' PSG hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
41' 2:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
40' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
38' The resulting set piece from Le Havre is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
36' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Kang-In Lee (PSG).
35' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) is adjudged offside.
29' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
29' Le Havre earn a corner.
26' What a sweet pass and great technique by Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) as he finds his teammate with a precise lofted through ball.
24' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
24' What a chance that is! Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header crashes off the crossbar!
20' Luis Enrique is forced to make a change. Goncalo Ramos is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Randal Kolo Muani (PSG).
17' Kang-In Lee (PSG) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
15' The game is interrupted. Goncalo Ramos (PSG) suffers a horrific injury!
15' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Willy Delajod had an easy-decision to make.
15' A player from Le Havre pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. PSG are awarded the free kick.
14' Willian Pacho (PSG) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Willy Delajod has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
13' PSG hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
10' Kang-In Lee (PSG) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Ibrahim Mbaye, but Arthur Desmas displays great awareness to stop him.
6' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from PSG.
3' 0 - 1 Goal! Goncalo Ramos shows great vision to find Kang-In Lee (PSG) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the top left corner. 0:1.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. PSG will have the kick-off.
Willy Delajod is introduced as the referee for today's match.
